glosses: niemający zaufania do kogoś lub czegoś, mający sceptyczne usposobienie

examples.text: Jestem z natury nieufny, nie ufam nikomu.

glosses: Experiencing distrust, showing distrust, wary, sceptical, suspicious, doubtful.
Causing or giving rise to distrust.
Having mistrust, lacking trust (in someone or something).

examples.text: In the passage I met the nurse. She greeted me with a little smile; but I was mistrustful of professional cheerfulness that night.

glosses: Expressing or showing a lack of trust.

examples.text:
He lookt askew with his mistrustfull eyes,
And nycely trode, as thornes lay in his way
At last, having held a document before her glasses for nearly five minutes, she presented it across the counter; accompanying the act by another inquisitive and mistrustful glance—it was for J. E.
He led the way to the stable-yard accordingly, the Rat following with a most mistrustful expression […]

glosses: Having a suspicion, imagining or supposing (that something undesirable is the case).

examples.text: The mender of roads was now coming to himself, and was mistrustful of having made a mistake in his late demonstrations; but no.

Vp we gad, owt spredding oure sayls and make to the seaward:
Al creeks mistrustful with Greekish countrye refusing.

[…] stonish’d as night-wanderers often are,
Their light blown out in some mistrustful wood,
Even so confounded in the dark she lay,
Having lost the fair discovery of her way.
